name: exp4_randread_4k_nj1_qd256
job_text:
; Experiment 4: queue-depth / parallelism sweep, 4 KiB random read
; QD = iodepth per job, NJ = numjobs (results aggregated with group_reporting)
[global]
; --- target: the single disposable file prepared by scripts/prepare_testfile.py
filename=${TESTFILE}
allow_file_create=0
unlink=0
offset=0
size=${SIZE}
; --- engine / I/O path
ioengine=${ENGINE}
direct=${DIRECT}
thread=0
; --- timing
time_based=1
ramp_time=${RAMP}
runtime=${RUNTIME}
; --- reproducible, aligned random offsets (blockalign defaults to bs)
randseed=${SEED}
random_generator=tausworthe64
norandommap=1
; --- data pattern: incompressible pseudo-random buffer, generated once per job
refill_buffers=0
; --- statistics: total latency (submit + completion) percentiles
lat_percentiles=1
percentile_list=1:5:10:25:50:75:90:95:99:99.5:99.9:99.99
; aggregate numjobs>1 deliberately into one result (only exp4 parallel curve uses numjobs>1)
group_reporting=1

[qd_sweep]
rw=randread
bs=4k
iodepth=${QD}
numjobs=${NJ}
